blurb: Guests can explore three escape rooms disguised as exhibitions at the Cadavera family Manor. There is also an immersive theatre experience set in the 1920s underworld at the Speakeasy Cocktail Bar “Le 4e Mur” in Montreal, available only in French on Saturday afternoons. The business offers team building activities through their escape games and events, focusing on cooperation, listening, and problem solving.
